scenarios.title: Summon upkeep through a pack fight: golem and skeletons raised, minions standing at the end
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 24 with the points a played level gives (spent by the bot's leveler table), purse 3000, field start in the Blood Moor by debug goto 2 and monsters by debug spawn (CHEATED position and encounter: mechanics only, never evidence about balance).
scenarios.notes: Eight Fallen (a pack) beside a clvl 24 summoner. RED with combat.minionRead 0 is not expected: the knob only changes how the army is counted, so the scenario is RED when the upkeep or the read fails. U: the SME table has Raise Skeleton and a golem by clvl 24; Clay Golem is the first cast.

assert.why: engine census (debug minions): the army stands at the end

scenarios.title: Earned Act 1: a fresh Necromancer from the Rogue Encampment toward Andariel, zero setup writes
scenarios.provenance: No setup write at all: a fresh level 1 hero, town start, the bot on a d2d without lab verbs (the setup list is empty). Not CHEATED if no_writes holds. combat.minionRead 1 only reads.
scenarios.notes: The verdict of this drill is the end state: how far the campaign got. A red result is the finding (readiness doc section 6.3), not a scenario defect, unless the run is BLOCKED.

Andariel killed (record 6 bit 1, V docs/d2d-probes.md per the act1more notes)
